translations.name: LOUIS ROEDERER BRUT.
translations.description: Perhaps the most recognizable Champagne label in the world, and not by chance. It is one of the most friendly and pleasant Champagnes on the market, emphasizing the right balance between the elements that make it up. Elegant yet multi-layered, it is the perfect aperitif, while it can accompany a wide range of fine tastes.
